scenes.speech: Revenue closed September at five hundred seventy-one thousand, eight percent above budget and the best month of the year. Growth came from the new city stores, while online sales stayed flat for the third month in a row.

lead.text: Growth came from the two new city stores. Online sales stayed flat for the third month in a row.

scenes.speech: Gross margin reached thirty-four point two percent, up one point on August. Lower freight costs did most of the work, and discounts were kept under control during the end-of-season sale.

lead.text: Lower freight costs did most of the work. Discounts stayed under control during the end-of-season sale.

scenes.speech: Operating costs were one hundred twelve thousand, three percent over budget. Most of the gap is the opening of the second store, which should not repeat in October.

lead.text: Most of the gap is the second store opening, a one-off that should not repeat in October.

scenes.speech: The month ended with two point eight million in cash. That covers about seven months of fixed costs, so there is room to fund the third store without new debt.

lead.text: There is room to fund the third store without taking on new debt.

scenes.speech: Orders grew to four thousand two hundred, and the average ticket held steady at one hundred thirty-six. Next month the focus is on bringing online sales back to growth.

lead.text: Next month the focus is on bringing online sales back to growth.
